newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close firm as Greenspan warning shunned.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close firm as Greenspan warning shunned.

text.p: UK shares closed firm on Thursday as Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's latest warning against an over-valued Wall Street proved a damp squib and gilts were pulled higher by strong German bunds.

The FTSE 100 index closed 9.9 points higher at 4,339.2, with gainers in a two-to-one majority -- led by Standard Chartered amid upbeat comment following results on Wednesday. The December long gilt was up 17/32 at 113-3/16.
Dealers said investors had largely ignored today's strong U.S. data as well as Greenspan's comments that recent stock market gains could prove unsustainable.
